Sam (People Ops): Kiran is joining 06/01 but cant secure a biometric slot for the UK Skilled Worker BRP. VFS sites show no availability. Need options.
Kiran: Hi all, I tried central London and the outskirts. Everything blocked for 3+ weeks. Really worried about start paperwork.
Leah (Immigration): First pass: are you inside the UK with a vignette? If so, you can still travel to another centre. Also we can request sponsor escalation if start date is within 2 weeks.
Kiran: I am in the UK, have vignette ref ZX987654. Start is 2026-06-01.
visa-bot: Tip: some centres release cancellations early morning. Use incognito and try at 06:00 local. Also check ServiceNow alerts for emergency slots.
Sam (People Ops): Action: Kiran paste vignette and preferred centre. Leah will prepare sponsor expedition note. We will reimburse travel if you need to go farther.
Kiran: Vignette ZX987654. Preferred centre: London - Croydon. Phone +44 7888 112233.
Leah (Immigration): I called regional bookings and submitted an expedition request with sponsor letter and business justification at 11:40. They responded that confirmations take up to 72 hours. Will update here.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks. If escalation denied, we will look for earliest slot outside London and cover travel. Keep screenshots of searches.
Kiran: Appreciate it, team. Keeping schedule flexible.
